subject: Discovery recap: observability & evals - ZenHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap: observability & evals - ZenHealth

Hi Alex - thanks again for the time today. Really useful conversation; wanted to capture the key points, success criteria, and next steps so we're all aligned. TL;DR: ZenHealth wants improved observability for LLM-driven features + eval tooling to prevent regressions during model updates.

What we heard (pain points)
- Limited visibility into per-route latency and token cost across production prompts.
- No unified dashboard for prompt-level accuracy/quality and regression detection.
- Lack of tracing hooks to correlate SDK calls back to request/trace ids in our apps.
- Hard to maintain golden prompts and test sets for QA pre/post model rollouts.

Current stack (what you told us)
- Frontend & API: React + Go services (Kubernetes).
- Currently using a mix of hosted APIs and some in-house inference via a managed partner.
- Basic logging in Datadog, but not correlated to model inputs/outputs.

Success criteria for a pilot/POC
- Per-route observability dashboard showing latency, token usage, error rates, and sample outputs.
- Tracing hooks so each model call surfaces trace/span ids and request metadata.
- Golden prompt set + automated regression alerts when quality drops vs baseline (precision/recall or business metric).
- Rollout guardrails: canary + automatic rollback on quality regression or latency SLO violation.

Requested dashboards/features you asked to see
1) Per-route cost & latency heatmap + top slow/worst-performing prompts.
2) Diff view for model outputs against golden prompts (side-by-side).
3) Regression alerting configuration (thresholds, window, severity).
4) Tracing integration guide for Go SDK + sample trace correlations.

Next steps (agreed on call)
- We will send a short POC plan and the observability deck (attached) by EOD today.
- You'll share a sample set of ~50 golden prompts and 3 example production endpoints (route names + expected Q/A) - you mentioned procurement might need to loop in for data access.
- Schedule a demo of the console + tracing integration next week (proposed: Wed 7/22 AM PT).
- If procurement wants contract/PO details, we'll pull pricing/terms into the thread.

Attachments: redwood-observability-deck.pdf (overview + sample dashboards), golden-prompts.csv (template)

Thanks - I'll coordinate internally to build a focused demo for the dashboards and tracing hooks you requested.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0127
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: observability & evals - ZenHealth

Thanks Marissa - this summary looks perfect and covers what we discussed. A couple quick notes:

- Priorities: 1) tracing hooks and per-route latency/cost; 2) automated regression alerts tied to our clinical QA prompts; 3) rollback guardrails for model updates.
- For golden prompts, I can share an initial CSV (50 rows) by EOD Monday. I'll loop in procurement (procurement@zenhealth.com) if we need to start the legal/PO conversation - they'll want a simple SOW and pricing range before we proceed to a pilot.
- Wed 7/22 AM PT works for a demo - suggest 9:00 AM PT.

One additional ask: can you show an example of how the diff view surfaces meaningful semantic regressions rather than just token-level diffs? That will be important for our clinical reviewers.

Appreciate the quick turnaround - looking forward to the demo.

- Alex
Head of ML Platforms | ZenHealth
alex.johnson@zenhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T17:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Discovery recap: observability & evals - ZenHealth

Team - forwarding the recap from my call with ZenHealth. Key asks to prepare for the demo on 7/22 (9:00 AM PT):

Action items
- Rishi: prepare a demo flow that highlights the per-route cost/latency dashboard, the diff view for golden prompts, and the regression alert pipeline. Show a semantic-diff example (we can use embedding-based similarity + human-config thresholds).
- Vivek: prep the tracing integration notes for Go/K8s and a short snippet that instruments request IDs into model calls. Include recommended sampling rates and how to correlate with Datadog.
- Laura: I may need a short one-pager on pilot pricing and SOW template to send to procurement. Keep it scoped (30-day pilot, up to X tokens, support hours).

Attachments: redwood-observability-deck.pdf (sent to customer) - we should upload the sample deck to the shared drive and link it in the demo.

I'll share the golden prompts template and a proposed POC plan before EOD. Rishi/Vivek - can you confirm you have capacity to prepare this by Wed?

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-16T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Discovery recap: observability & evals - ZenHealth

Confirming - I'll build the demo notebook with:
- Embedded similarity-based semantic diff (example using sentence-transformers + cosine threshold).
- Live dashboard with synthetic traffic to show latency vs token cost per route.
- A regression-alert rule example (baseline vs rolling window + alert webhook).

I'll drop the demo artifacts and a short runbook into the shared drive link you included by EOD Tues. Vivek - if you can share the Go tracing snippet, I'll integrate it into the demo traces.

- Rishi
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
